3. Orange tulips grow from 1 orange flower seeds. However, we don't have seeds yet. So first gather the orange flower seeds.
4. Orange flower seeds can be obtained from orange pumpkin, which further requires cultivating orange pumpkin plants. Thus, start gathering orange pumpkins.
5. Orange pumpkins come from 1 melon slice, and melon slices grow from 1 melon. First collect the 2 melons from growing melon plants.
6. Now that we have melons, we can obtain melon slices from them.
7. We now have melon slices; time to get the orange pumpkin from orange pumpkin plants.
8. With the orange pumpkin, we finally receive orange flower seeds.
9. Gather the orange flower seeds and 1 orange tulip to create orange dye.
10. Utilize 1 glass to make 1 glass pane for the recipe for orange stained glass pane.
11. With 8 glass and 8 glass panes, we can make an initial attempt to craft an orange stained glass pane as it's an essential ingredient for an orange dye, but this time without dye, which leads us back to step 7 to make some dye again.
12. Make sure we now have enough dye to continue by following step 10 and step 9.
13. Combine 8 glass with the orange dye to make 8 orange stained glass.
14. Each orange stained glass can be combined with the corresponding glass pane to make the final orange stained glass pane, but since only orange stained glass was our immediate goal, we stop here once we get those.

Final sequence:

- Gather orange flowers (orange flower seeds)
- Grow orange pumpkins (from orange flowers).
- Collect melon slices (from melons) to grow more melons and obtain more orange flowers.
- Make orange dye from orange tulip (grown from orange pumpkins).
- Create orange stained glass from the 8 glass and 1 orange dye.
- Craft the rest of the necessary components like dye, stained glass, etc. as needed, until all are completed.
